items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: I had a drummer working with me, Richard

ctx.x: When you were leading your own band and playing gigs if people came up and requested a current rock tune or something, what did you do?

Well you know sometimes, sometimes we could play it because I had a drummer working with me, Richard — aw I forget the man’s last name. Anyway, he could play Dixieland, he could play rock, he could play jazz, blues. He knew that God damn drumset © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

so good and knew the rhythms. That’s the important thing. He knew those rhythms and he would play them and play them comfortable. So if they asked for a rock tune, what I would do, I had some blues/rock things with the background, and I would play them. “Oh yeah, you played rock.” I said, “Yeah, we play rock.”
